resources.string: Save the place where I am
Swipe a card to the left to remove it.
The location could not be found. Check that location is turned on in the phone.

For the Current location to be refreshed also while the app is closed (widgets, notifications, background refresh), choose Allow all the time in the location settings. Only the last position is kept, without any history.
Location in the background is allowed.
Location in the background is not allowed: the Current location is refreshed only while the app is open.
The app has only the approximate location (about 2 km). The name of the place or the country near a border may be wrong.
The location permission was not granted.
Saves the place where you are now as an ordinary location. When you leave, the weather is still shown for this place.
The location moves with you: the weather, widgets and notifications are where you are, also while the app is closed if you allow it. There can be only one followed location.
